# Rack Extension build via pongasoft re-cmake. Generated by `rebench new`.
# Copy cmake-build-config.local.cmake.example to cmake-build-config.local.cmake,
# set your SDK paths, then:
#   cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && build/re.sh install   (re.bat on Windows)
# GUI2D/*.png is globbed when CMake configures: re-run CMake after adding art.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake-build-config.local.cmake" OPTIONAL)
if(NOT DEFINED RE_SDK_VERSION)
  set(RE_SDK_VERSION "4.6.0")
endif()

include(FetchContent)
if(NOT DEFINED RE_CMAKE_ROOT)
  FetchContent_Declare(re-cmake
      GIT_REPOSITORY "https://github.com/pongasoft/re-cmake"
      GIT_TAG        v1.8.5
      GIT_SHALLOW    true
      SOURCE_DIR     "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/re-cmake-src"
      SOURCE_SUBDIR  "do_not_make_available")
  FetchContent_MakeAvailable(re-cmake)
  set(RE_CMAKE_ROOT "${re-cmake_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(re-cmake_ROOT_DIR "${RE_CMAKE_ROOT}")
include("${RE_CMAKE_ROOT}/main.cmake")
re_cmake_before_project_init()

project(@@CMAKE_PROJECT@@ LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(NOT DEFINED RE_SDK_ROOT OR NOT DEFINED RE_2D_RENDER_ROOT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set RE_SDK_ROOT and RE_2D_RENDER_ROOT in cmake-build-config.local.cmake.")
endif()
re_cmake_init()

set(CPP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/cpp")
file(GLOB GUI2D_PNGS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/GUI2D/*.png")

set(RE_ARGS
    RE_SDK_VERSION      "${RE_SDK_VERSION}"
    RE_SDK_ROOT         "${RE_SDK_ROOT}"
    RE_2D_RENDER_ROOT   "${RE_2D_RENDER_ROOT}"
    BUILD_SOURCES       "${CPP_DIR}/Device.cpp" "${CPP_DIR}/JukeboxExports.cpp"
    RENDER_2D_SOURCES   "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/GUI2D/device_2D.lua"
                        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/GUI2D/hdgui_2D.lua"
                        ${GUI2D_PNGS}
    INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CPP_DIR}")
if(DEFINED RE_2D_PREVIEW_ROOT)
  list(APPEND RE_ARGS RE_2D_PREVIEW_ROOT "${RE_2D_PREVIEW_ROOT}")
endif()
if(DEFINED RE_RECON_EXECUTABLE)
  list(APPEND RE_ARGS RE_RECON_EXECUTABLE "${RE_RECON_EXECUTABLE}")
endif()
add_re_plugin(${RE_ARGS})
